component.name: MovieItem
component.script:
sub init() m.poster = m.top.findNode("poster") m.title = m.top.findNode("title") m.focusRect = m.top.findNode("focusRect") m.placeholder = m.top.findNode("placeholder") m.placeholderLabel = m.top.findNode("placeholderLabel")
m.poster.observeField("loadStatus", "onPosterLoadStatus") end sub
sub onContentChange() item = m.top.itemContent if item <> invalid ' Siempre mostrar el gris primero m.placeholder.visible = true m.placeholderLabel.visible = true m.poster.visible = false
m.poster.uri = item.hdPosterUrl m.title.text = item.title end if end sub
sub onPosterLoadStatus() status = m.poster.loadStatus ' ready = imagen cargó bien ' failed / loading / none = mantener gris if status = "ready" m.placeholder.visible = false m.placeholderLabel.visible = false m.poster.visible = true else if status = "failed" m.placeholder.visible = true m.placeholderLabel.visible = true m.poster.visible = false end if end sub
sub onFocusChange() focused = m.top.focusPercent > 0.5 m.focusRect.visible = focused if focused m.title.color = "0xFFFFFFFF" else m.title.color = "0xCCCCCCFF" end if end sub
